title: The 6 Best String Trimmers Under $200
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for string trimmers under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at string trimmers under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EGO Power+ ST1521S 15-Inch String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-inch cutting swath with POWERLOAD auto-feed, 56V ARC Lithium battery, 2.5Ah included, Carbon fiber split shaft.
strengths: POWERLOAD auto-feed removes the most annoying part of trimmer maintenance
Carbon fiber shaft keeps weight down despite the larger battery and motor
limitations: Near the top of this price band once accessories are added
56V battery doesn't interchange with more common 40V ecosystems

products.name: Husqvarna 128LD Gas String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 28cc 2-cycle gas engine, 17-inch cutting swath, Straight shaft with Tap 'n Go head.
strengths: More raw cutting power than any battery trimmer at this price
17-inch swath and unlimited runtime suit larger properties
Click-on attachment compatibility adds versatility for edging and blowing
limitations: Requires mixed fuel, oil, and periodic carburetor maintenance
Heavier and louder than the EGO or any cordless model
features: Straight shaft with Tap 'n Go head

products.name: Worx WG183 40V String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 13-inch dual-exit cutting head, 40V PowerShare, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included, Under 5 pounds.
strengths: Two batteries included covers most yards without a runtime concern
limitations: Less motor power and swath width than the EGO or Husqvarna
Not the pick if maximum cutting performance is the goal at this budget
features: Typically under $100, leaving room in a $200 budget for accessories

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12-Inch Cordless String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch cutting swath, 40V lithium battery, 2.0Ah included, Dual line auto-feed.
strengths: 3-year warranty adds confidence at a budget price
Adequate performance for small to medium yards
limitations: Narrowest swath and smallest battery in this comparison
